description: Draw a path through points. Each point is [x, y], or an object with x, y and optional curve handles in and out ([x, y] in the same coordinates)

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

fill.description: Fill. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

layer.description: Layer to draw on. Default: the active layer

name.description: Name for the new item (shown in the Layers panel)

stroke.description: Stroke colour. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

name: create_path
title: Create Path
